next.reason: Same. 1985: as each print line is presented LINE-COUNTER is its line number; the value after a group follows the presentation rules tables (their final LINE-COUNTER setting rules: the last line presented, or the NEXT GROUP setting). 2023 §2023:8.4.3.15.4 GR4 'the value of LINE-COUNTER specifies the line number of the page on which the line is printed', afterwards the last line printed unless the NEXT GROUP rules define it. The dummy/suppressed-group case is 1985 XIII.3.5.6 rule 5, a separate record (2023 GR5).
